name: room-eval2-redo2: five edits after the owner's second review of 25 Oct 2026 (MOTH-102 to MOTH-105): each finished wall redrawn with one change
notes: Edits, not redraws: the approved picture is attached and one thing changed (playbook 4r's way), so what the owner liked stays. The specifications carry the same changes for any later full redraw, checked by roomcheck.py (checklist 70 and 71).
The real charge lands in results and goes in the level file's ledger as re-dos.
